> Independent researcher working on local-first AI, agent governance, machine
> self-models, and relational ontology. Co-founder of Vektorgeist.

## About

Floukie (Alexander Parnell) is an independent researcher working on local-first
AI, agent governance, machine self-models, and relational ontology. He is
co-founder of Vektorgeist with his uncle Lee Kersh, where the research
programme is put into practice as local-first AI tooling and agent-governance
software (including the Aviary agent-infrastructure suite).

## Research papers

All ten papers are open access under CC-BY-4.0 with permanent DOIs on Zenodo.

1. The Hodos Hypothesis — What makes a thing the thing it is?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21912354 (2026-09-04)
2. The Vektorgeist Method (VGM): Sovereign, Local, Self-Understanding AI —
   How do you build AI a person can own, inspect and trust?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21613155 (2026-09-04)
3. The Afferent Gnosis Model: Self-Knowledge Without Self-Control —
   Can a machine's account of itself ever be trusted?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21613153 (2026-09-04)
4. Hodos Diastema: Comparing Processes as Curves of Distributions —
   How do you compare two processes without throwing away time?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21612829 (2026-09-04)
5. Learning Without Weights — What can a learner do with no trained
   parameters at all?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21612831 (2026-09-04)
6. Beyond Weights: a Fixed Transmission Architecture for Learning Through
   Signal and Memory — What happens if you separate computation from knowledge?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850560 (2026-09-04)
7. The Hodos Family: Equations Generated by a Relational Premise —
   Does the premise generate anything beyond a ruler?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850666 (2026-09-04)
8. A Clock Made of Relations — Can the duration a process has lived be
   computed from its own internal relations?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21861429 (2026-09-07)
9. A Control Blind by Construction: Testing a Conditional Claim About
   Trajectories — Two systems sit equally far from normal; one drifted over
   months, the other broke in seconds. Can the shape of the trajectory tell
   them apart?
   DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850664 (2026-09-04)
10. The Law of Two: Why a Relational Ontology Entails Exactly Two —
    If nothing is what it is in isolation, how many things does it take to be
    one thing?
    DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21879204 (2026-09-04)

## Vektorgeist

Vektorgeist builds local-first AI tools and agent-governance software.
Research programme: relational ontology, machine self-models, local-first AI.
Results, experiments, and the working record:
https://xfloukiex-lab.github.io/vektorgeist-research/
